meta.subject: Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Science Standard Six Term III 2024 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from lesson text, activities, infographics, diagrams, ICT, Lavoisier feature, evaluation, HOTS, crossword, graph and rainfall-map task. No outside answers are silently supplied for research prompts.
source_notes: Both uploaded Term III 2024 English and Tamil books were used.
The Lavoisier feature on printed pages 26–27 appears inside the Unit 2 source file before the Water evaluation and is therefore retained as part of the Unit 2 source bank.

The evaluation asks students to research the 'Waterman of India' and awards using the internet; because the textbook itself does not provide that answer, no outside answer is inserted into this source-only bank.
The rainfall-map exercise is retained as a map-reading task; district classifications are not invented where the rendered colour categories are not unambiguous in parsed text.
Graph questions use only visually clear comparisons (maximum/minimum) rather than inventing precise unlabeled percentages.
